statements.status_notes: This debug-log credential exposure was fixed in Snyk CLI 1.1297.3 (go-application-framework commit ca7ba7d). This image ships snyk 1.1306.0, which is past the fix and includes the corrected log-sanitization code. The advisory data marks the go-application-framework module with an affected range of >=0, which false-positives on the fixed release bundled here.
